name: Southern Bog Clubmoss
desc: Southern Bog Clubmoss (Lycopodiella appressa): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Lycopodiella appressa, commonly known as southern bog clubmoss, is a species of clubmoss. It is native to eastern North America, including Cuba and the West Indies.
